hints.title: Prefix Invariance
hints.text: Notice that applying an operation to any prefix shifts all elements within that prefix uniformly.

hints.title: Mismatch Independence
hints.text: Whenever two adjacent elements nums[i] and nums[i-1] differ, an operation boundary must separate them to bring them to equal values.

hints.title: Pair Counting
hints.text: Count the number of indices i from 1 to n-1 where nums[i] does not equal nums[i-1].

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Counts adjacent mismatched values across a single linear pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Applying actual prefix transformations explicitly takes quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that each mismatch between adjacent elements requires an independent prefix operation.
